name: fb-video-block
description: Chrome extension that stops Facebook videos and Reels from autoplaying.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.package: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/fb-video-block.zip && cd extension && zip -qr ../dist/fb-video-block.zip . && echo 'dist/fb-video-block.zip ready'
